title: Q-TEST-TIMEBOMB-1: tests with a fixed date clock that exercise SQL using the real clock fail when the date ages out
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** issueloop and queue --run, daily
**Done check:** grep:workers/tools/timebomb.test.mjs::datetime\('now'
**Status:** open

Found 2026-11-18: `workers/packs/cloud/cloud.test.js` used T0 = 2026-11-11 while the manifest read probes use `datetime('now', '-7 days')`; main went red exactly 7 days later with no code change (fixed in the same PR by starting the clock an hour ago). Twenty-plus other test files pin `Date.parse('2026-11-1x')`.

Remedy: a test in `workers/tools/` that fails when a test file pins a calendar date and the module or manifest it loads contains `datetime('now'` or `Date.now()` windows, so the class is caught at authoring time.

**Closing probe:** `grep:workers/tools/timebomb.test.mjs::datetime\('now'`
